status: DRAFT; root review and publication required
scope: Frozen rear-flange, port registration, angle/offset candidates, heater candidate and route evidence; all failures preserved. No installation claim.
prerequisite_chain_in_restore_order: installed neck-core and predecessor chain documented by docs/CAD-ARTIFACTS.md
exclusions: All reference originals, purchased manuals and owner photographs
All active accessory carriers and bearing work
Canonical manifests and shared documentation modifications
restorability_limits: Artifact-only supplement; obtain source/report/handoff files through reviewed repository commit. Several listed files are currently untracked, root must preserve them in commit.
Restore predecessor archives before this supplement. Individual report inputs remain authoritative, not latest arbitrary STEP files.
Private corrected-engine-stage-v3 manifest and CAD helper sources must match original report hashes. Archive does not make current canonical engine equal to v3.
Source registration/route scripts require excluded original reference photographs/manual/catalog PDF; numeric fit reports and own plots are included, source re-evaluation is not source-independent.
No full clean-clone rebuild, CAD re-execution, browser or installation acceptance is implied by archive verification.
Original metric exceptions, source uncertainty, main3 tool conflict, angle/offset sensitivity and five heater tube collisions remain.

The neck-core predecessor metadata has no per-member hashes: active definition dependencies are bound to frozen report/current local hashes, but predecessor archive membership has not been independently extracted/verified in this packaging task. Remaining unmatched dependencies are explicitly listed.
